contentHtml:
Imagine having a pass that lets you fly in and out of the UAE freely for five years.

No repeat applications.

No long queues.

Just land, enter, and enjoy.

That is exactly what the 5-year multiple-entry visit visa UAE offers when you understand how it works.Below is a clean breakdown of the price, requirements, limitations, and how TheUAEGate can help you apply without stress. We’ve incorporated the latest information from official UAE sources, including the ICP and GDRFA.

Let us make it simple, direct, and real.

Understanding the 5-Year Multiple-Entry Visa

  • This visa permits multiple entries and exits to the UAE within a 5-year validity period. 
  • You can stay up to 90 consecutive days per visit. This may be extended once for another 90 days which totals a maximum of 180 days per calendar year.
  • It’s designed for frequent travelers — people who travel for business, family visits, or repeated tourism. No local sponsor or host required; it’s self-sponsored.

This visa removes the need to apply repeatedly. Once you have it, reuse it as long as it remains valid. Just track your annual stay to avoid overstay fines (AED 50 per day).

5-Year Multiple Entry Visit Visa UAE Price: Current Cost Guide

Prices vary based on insurance, admin, documentation and travel requirements. Government fees are lower, but agencies bundle for convenience. Here’s the most updated range:

Type Approximate Price (AED) Notes
Government Base Fee (via ICP/GDRFA) 300–1,000 + 5% VAT Includes issuance; excludes insurance/processing.
Standard Agency Package 868–3,000 Full service with insurance, docs validation, and express options.
Premium Packages 3,000–5,000 Includes refundable deposits, priority processing (2 days), or family add-ons.
Extra Costs 40–90 (insurance) + 10–20 (knowledge/innovation fees) Mandatory health insurance; medical tests if required (~AED 300).

Always check inclusions—insurance is non-negotiable. Direct applications save money but require a UAE Pass setup. For frequent flyers, it pays off vs. short-term visas (e.g., 30-day at AED 350 each time).

Documents You Will Need

To get the 5-year multiple-entry visit visa, provide these documents. Upload scanned versions when applying online.

  1. Passport: 6 months validity required.
  2. Photo: Passport-size with white background.
  3. Financial Proof: Last 6-month bank statement showing about USD 4,000 balance
  4. Health Insurance: UAE-valid coverage starting around AED 40 to 90.
  5. Travel Itinerary: Return or onward ticket.
  6. Application Form: Fill it out online through the portal or app.

Once you get it, the visa is good for 5 years with multiple entries. You can stay for about 90 days each time you visit.

Pros & Cons: What Works and What You Must Watch For

What you get

  • No repeated visa applications. Travel as you need for over 5 years.
  • Gives you the freedom to travel for holidays, work meetings, or to see family without applying again and again.
  • Saves money since you won’t need new short-term visas again and again.
  • Suits people who work online, manage business abroad, or visit family often.

What to keep in mind

  • Some visa packages require financial proof or a security deposit.
  • The stay window is roughly 90 days per visit. For year-round living, another visa is needed.
  • Renewal/re-entry may need valid insurance and a passport. A return ticket and proof of funds might also be required.
  • You must follow visa conditions. Not all 5-year visas allow work or long-term stay.

Who Should Consider the 5-Year Multiple Entry Visa

This visa type works best for people such as:

  • Frequent business travelers come from abroad (e.g., GCC meetings).
  • Entrepreneurs or freelancers with clients or operations across GCC & UAE.
  • Family visitors (e.g., seeing parents/kids studying there).
  • Digital nomads needing short, periodic stays
  • Investors/remote workers requiring occasional access without full relocation.

All nationalities eligible if docs/funds check out—no prior UAE visa history required.

Is the 5-Year Multiple Entry Visit Visa Worth It? Final Take

For frequent UAE visitors, yes it’s a game-changer. Ditch paperwork hassles, save on fees, and enjoy seamless access for 5 years. But it’s not for long-term living/work (go for residence visas instead).
